summary: Tested new features: Pre-checkout discount popup and Admin Push Notifications system. All backend APIs pass (12/12 tests). Frontend UI testing confirms both features are fully functional.

issues: Minor: 'Apply Code First' button text could be clearer - changes to 'Checkout with Discount' when code is applied

critical_code_review_comments: OneSignal web push shows 'App not configured for web push' error in console - this is expected as noted by main agent. OneSignal needs dashboard configuration for web push to work.
Discount validation returns 404 for invalid codes - this is correct behavior
All notification API endpoints properly require admin authentication (401 returned for unauthenticated requests)
context_for_next_testing_agent: New features (discount popup and notifications) are fully functional. OneSignal web push requires dashboard configuration to send actual notifications - API endpoints work correctly.

pre_checkout_discount_popup.details: Popup appears when clicking Subscribe button. Contains: discount code input, Apply button, Skip & Checkout button, Checkout with Discount button. Shows tip with available discount codes (WELCOME20, 7DAYS).

discount_code_validation.details: /api/discount/validate endpoint works correctly. Returns 404 for invalid codes, 200 for valid codes with discount info.

visible_discounts_endpoint.details: /api/discount/visible returns list of visible discount codes for promotional banners.

admin_notifications_tab.details: Notifications tab visible in Admin Dashboard with Bell icon. Tab is clickable and shows notification form.

notification_form_fields.details: Form contains: Title input (50 char limit), Message textarea (200 char limit), Target Audience dropdown (Everyone/Unsubscribed/Subscribed), Deep Link URL input, Preview section, Send Notification button.

notification_send_endpoint.details: /api/admin/notifications/send accepts title, message, target, url parameters. Returns success response with notification_id and recipients count.

notification_history_endpoint.details: /api/admin/notifications/history returns list of sent notifications with sent_at, title, message, target, recipients fields.

notification_auth_required.details: Both /send and /history endpoints return 401 for unauthenticated requests.

api_verification./api/discount/validate: POST - Validates discount code for specific tier. Returns discount info or 404.
api_verification./api/discount/visible: GET - Returns list of visible discount codes for promotional banners.
api_verification./api/admin/notifications/send: POST - Sends push notification via OneSignal. Requires admin auth.
api_verification./api/admin/notifications/history: GET - Returns notification history. Requires admin auth.

onesignal_note: OneSignal shows 'App not configured for web push' error in console. This is expected - OneSignal needs dashboard configuration for web push. The API endpoints work correctly and will send notifications once OneSignal is properly configured.
